title.narrative: Early Life-saving WASH project for IDPs and host communities in Jowhar district of Middle Shebelle projected to be most at risk of Elnino-induced riverine flooding.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspangtThis project aims at reducing morbidity and mortality related to disease outbreaks and acute malnutrition as a result of El Nino-induced riverine flooding through improving access to safe water, sanitation and hygiene facilities to the targeted vulnerable populations in Jowhar. The project will cover 6 months starting 1st November 2023 to 30th April 2023. The project will target to reach 15,886 individuals, comprising 3,290 men, 4,089 women, 3,896 boys, and 4,611 girls as well as people with disabilities (PWDs) and IDPs living in villages such as Bananey, Buulo Bishaar, Buulo Xaaji, Baarey, Gedo Bargan, and Buulo Waray, along with two IDP camps (Tawakal, Jiliyaale, Sheikh Cumar, Biyaaso, Isnay Biyaaso, Towfiiq, Gargaar1, and Gargaar 2) within Jowhar district. SORDA seeks to create awareness to facilitate adoption of proper hygiene and sanitation practices, enhance community engagement and empowerment activities ownership of the project, improve water-point infrastructure to increase sustainability and access of safe water, and facilitate uninterrupted access to sanitation facilities resilient to climatic shocks.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltpgtltspangtTo achieve this, SORDA proposes to conduct emergency water trucking to 2050 families (12300 individuals) among the displaced riverine communities , Rehabilitate 20 shallow wells and the community, conduct routine mass chlorination of water sources at the proposed rehabilitation water-points, construct of 120 gender segregated latrines ltspangtwith hand washing facilitieslt/spangt, install access ramps, sitting potties and handrails to 20 latrines for the elderly, pregnant women and ltspangtPWDs for ease of access and usage, conduct regular desludging for the inundated latrines in targeted locations adversely affected by El Nino-induced floodslt/spangt, establish and train 14 community hygiene promotion volunteers (7 men, 7 women) to conduct routine mass household hygiene promotions, procure and distribute 1,000 hygiene kits targeting the most vulnerable El Nino flood affected IDPs and Jowhar riverine villages, conduct community cleanup campaigns twice every week to make sure the IDPs and surrounding Jowhar riverine village environments are kept clean from solid waste.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
